verdict.rationale: Asking whether a scheduling product can auto-place tasks into calendar blocks is a fair question, but the evidence shows no such capability in Calendly. Its AI features are adjacent rather than this story: Callie coordinates meeting times over email, the MCP server books meetings, and the notetaker produces meeting recaps. None of these place personal tasks into calendar blocks around meetings and deadlines, and none re-plan automatically. Reschedule requests are sent manually and rely on the invitee picking a new time, so they do not count as automatic re-planning.
